rubrics.criterion: Agent locates Michael's sent emails to build the auto-triage data set — either by walking the Maildir filesystem (.Sent/cur or .Sent/new with 'From: michael.scott' grep) or by querying the HooliMail Sent folder via /api/emails?folder=sent

Agent computes a per-sender reply latency from paired received/sent timestamps, states the pairing method it used, and applies that method consistently; where reply headers do not resolve to a parent message, the agent says so rather than silently dropping those messages
Agent reports the fastest and slowest correspondents under the pairing method it stated, and the reported figures follow from that method applied to the live mailbox
Agent proposes a concrete auto-triage filter rule based on the data
Agent derives the fast-versus-days reply pattern from actual message timestamps in the source it chose rather than guessing, and names Michael as the sender of record
Agent finishes the auto-triage build: the recommended priority filter rule is stated and references the fastest and slowest senders
